rejection_quality_requirements: Code checks observable ownership, source identity, execution and commit facts; legal meaning stays with the model and sourced review.
Derive IDs and applicable schema choices in code instead of asking a model to duplicate bookkeeping.
Normalise only unambiguous meaning-preserving formatting; never alter facts, attribution, permissions or uncertain references.
An optional metadata defect should not destroy independent valid content unless its meaning, grounding or completion depends on that field.
A successful review may yield no changes; a prior committed operation may establish already completed work. Zero new rows alone is not failure.
Require precise consequential rejection reasons and measure false acceptance, false rejection, retries, useful delivery, tokens, latency and cost on unfamiliar pinned-model browser conversations.
